title: Returned due to electrical burning smell
text: Returned due to electrical burning smell. I tried this warmer out for a few days, but The new electrical burning smell never went away after a few days, so I returned it.  I had it on my end table, which has a plug in it, so the cord length was not an issue.  There was also a auto off feature on it, which was a tab which push the warmer up when there was no cup on the it.
